decisions.reason: The area elastic sports floor builds on the firm's wood-surface and production know-how, and its own R&D lets it interpret results and refine the system, even though sports floors lie outside its residential, trend-led direction.
The mobile arena floor draws on established hardwood engineering the firm can assimilate and improve, although it overlaps with a similar system.
Related knowledge supports keeping this mobile arena floor, but duplication with Product B makes it the more likely candidate for consolidation.
The chevron parquet sits at the core of the firm's premium, style-oriented flooring knowledge and its strategic direction, and it was featured on the home page.
The squash court finish applies the firm's surface-finishing expertise, so it can learn from early results, though it serves a small niche.
The oak skirting is a simple accessory based on core oak processing that complements the sports floor systems, with low cost to maintain.
